label: In-order dual-issue
notes: 7-stage dual-issue in-order core with FP subset (main, end of step 2)

label: OoO M1
notes: Tomasulo OoO, recovery at commit, loads wait for older stores

label: OoO M2
notes: + early branch recovery (rename checkpoints, squash at execute)

label: OoO M3
notes: + store-queue to load forwarding (stall attribution added in M4 option 0)

label: M4.1 predictor
notes: gshare 512 x 8-bit history, BTFN for cold entries, branch targets at fetch, BTB 16 (jalr only)

label: M4.6 store drain
notes: store buffer drains every cycle (depth 8 measured: no gain, kept 4)

label: M4.3 wider fetch
notes: slot 1 after compressed/unaligned slot 0; dispatch past predicted not-taken branches

label: M4.4 two ALUs
notes: second integer ALU (dual-issue ALU RS, 8 entries) + third CDB

label: M4.5 fast FP CSRs
notes: fflags accesses and frm/fcsr reads no longer serialize

label: M5.1-2 mul/div units
notes: iterative integer divider (~35 cycles), 3-stage pipelined integer multiplier; ALU without M ops

label: M5.3 issue/execute split
notes: ALUs/branch execute from registers, own CDBs; speculative tag wake-up; no CDB-to-dispatch bypass

label: M5.4 rising-edge register files
notes: register files write on the rising edge (forwarding unchanged)

label: M5.5 rising-edge caches and memory
notes: Caches, memory model and MMIO on the rising edge; drain path, HPM events and memory-queue operand mux shortened

label: M5.6 registered FP rounding, parallel slot-1 prediction
notes: FP add/mul latency 2->3, fdiv +1 cycle; D-cache FSM busy registered; slot-1 predictor looks up both candidate PCs

label: Z7-20 prep: LUTRAM ROB, no L2
notes: ROB allocation-only fields in LUT RAM banks, narrowed completion fields; L2 optional (off)
